# Prop & set index (auto-generated)

Every library in `engine/kit/lib/`. Import in a project's `scenes/shots/all.js` as `import * as XX from '../lib/<file>.js'` and draw inside an `fn((g, t, info) => …)` overlay.
Sets (backgrounds) are named in `engine.js` → `SETS`; use them as `set: '<name>'` in a shot.
